placement.reason: Nearest qualifying existing platform by original-room distance, then position

evidence.scope: Initial placement only; later destruction, AI motion, visibility and firing must be observed during the run
checks: full-width rectangular solid floor at identical height
continuous body clearance without walls, steps, shelves, ladders, doors, water or traps
no existing physical box or door intersects the full corridor
native line-of-sight from five player poses to all six enemy poses

fixtureKnockback.purpose: Keep the private target on the selected floor; not native gameplay acceptance
